tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get current profile state, completion percentage, and a guide on how to fill it out

tools.name: set_basics
tools.description: Set your name, tagline, and MBTI type

tools.name: add_card
tools.description: Add a profile card with emoji and auto-generated Open Peeps illustration. Max 6 cards. Choose a category that best matches the card topic — the illustration is generated automatically. Available categories: coding, mobile, data, infra, security, design, art, photo, music, writing, marketing, sales, finance, strategy, startup, leadership, teaching, speaking, teamwork, networking, fitness, travel, cooking, gaming, reading, legal, medical, science, education, nonprofit. Each category produces a unique hand-drawn character illustration with themed background.

emoji.description: Emoji icon for the card (e.g. 🚀, 🎨). Required.

category.description: Category for auto-generated illustration. Options: coding, mobile, data, infra, security, design, art, photo, music, writing, marketing, sales, finance, strategy, startup, leadership, teaching, speaking, teamwork, networking, fitness, travel, cooking, gaming, reading, legal, medical, science, education, nonprofit. Pick the one that best matches the card topic.

tools.name: remove_card
tools.description: Remove a profile card by its index (0-based)

index.description: Index of the card to remove (0-based)

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Update an existing card's title, description, emoji, and/or illustration by index (0-based). Provide a category to regenerate the illustration with a new Open Peeps character. Available categories: coding, mobile, data, infra, security, design, art, photo, music, writing, marketing, sales, finance, strategy, startup, leadership, teaching, speaking, teamwork, networking, fitness, travel, cooking, gaming, reading, legal, medical, science, education, nonprofit.

index.description: Index of the card to update (0-based)

title.description: New title (leave empty to keep current)

description.description: New description (leave empty to keep current)

category.description: Category for regenerating illustration. Options: coding, mobile, data, infra, security, design, art, photo, music, writing, marketing, sales, finance, strategy, startup, leadership, teaching, speaking, teamwork, networking, fitness, travel, cooking, gaming, reading, legal, medical, science, education, nonprofit. Leave empty to keep current illustration.

tools.name: update_tagline
tools.description: Update only the tagline without changing other basics

tools.name: set_available_for
tools.description: Set availability tags. Presets: Coffee, Sake, Side Project, Mentoring, Just Talk, Workout, Study, Business, Networking, Travel, Gaming, Language Exchange

tags.description: Availability tags. Presets: Coffee, Sake, Side Project, Mentoring, Just Talk, Workout, Study, Business, Networking, Travel, Gaming, Language Exchange. Custom values allowed.

tools.name: set_vibes
tools.description: Set vibe keywords (max 3). Presets: Chill, Energetic, Nerdy, Creative, Ambitious, Open-minded, Introverted, Adventurous, Analytical, Empathetic, Spontaneous, Focused

vibes.description: Vibe keywords (max 3). Presets: Chill, Energetic, Nerdy, Creative, Ambitious, Open-minded, Introverted, Adventurous, Analytical, Empathetic, Spontaneous, Focused. Custom values allowed.

tools.name: set_looking_for
tools.description: Describe what kind of people you want to meet

text.description: What kind of people you want to meet (max 500 characters)

tools.name: set_contacts
tools.description: Set contact info. Valid platforms: instagram, linkedin, x, github, youtube, website, reddit

tools.name: set_avatar
tools.description: Generate and set an Open Peeps style avatar using DiceBear. Provide a seed (usually the user's name) to generate a unique, consistent avatar. The avatar is hand-drawn style with warm paper background.

seed.description: Seed for avatar generation. Usually the user's name. Same seed always produces the same avatar.

tools.name: get_preview_url
tools.description: Get the URL to preview your finished profile
